scope: Independent static review of the frozen source-copy helpers and owner-provided control evidence; no original source-copy command or database connection executed by the reviewer.

sharedDependencyReviewed.scope: Canonical hashing and bounded UTF-8/duplicate-member/nonfinite JSON parsing only; existing capacity execution tools were not run.

closedFindings.resolution: The helper no longer relies on terminating the host Docker client to bound the remote Node process. A fixed 35-second in-container watchdog covers imports, Client connect, reads, rollback/end and awaited stdout completion; the metadata-only DNS probe has a 7-second internal watchdog. Host limits remain 45 and 10 seconds.
Generated copy and probe programs await stdout write completion before clearing their internal watchdog, including bounded sanitized failure output.

Both the cable byte preflight and cable row query join cable_types by type ID and project ID. Non-null missing/foreign type joins are refused; an explicitly unresolved all-null triple remains distinct from normal e1ef NOT NULL schema state.
The two original-container helper exec commands clear NODE_OPTIONS only for their own process; no container environment/configuration change or environment-value disclosure is needed.

reviewedGuards: Closed Docker metadata projection excludes Config.Env; exact original backend/PostgreSQL ID, image, start time, network and published port are checked.
Private DATABASE_URL remains inside the original backend. The explicit Docker Desktop host-published route and SQL server address/port/database are verified before project SELECTs.
URI endpoint and option/file indirection are checked before parsing; only parsed pg config is passed, followed by fixed read-only startup options and timeouts, without connectionString reparsing.

Raw pg Client imports no application bootstrap. The transaction is repeatable-read/read-only, checks effective/default read-only state, and uses fixed SELECT/SET LOCAL/BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK statements.
Project UUID/name, active same-project model, converted fingerprint and exactly five pinned property-resource entries are fenced.

Cables use deterministic ordering, LIMIT 100001, row cap 100000 and conservative byte preflight before materializing text. Raw decimal strings, names, nulls, MTO and PostgreSQL timestamp microseconds are retained without defaults/category inference.

Exclusive owner-marked private outputs and readback hashes preserve raw phase bytes/failure metadata before validation; before/copy/after project/selection/model/cable comparisons are persisted before equality assertions.
Sanitized compact receipts contain no URI, credentials, query values, user records or business rows. External/unexplained projection changes fail closed without automatic retry.

ownerExecutedChecks.reviewerVerification: Current four source hashes, owner receipt hash and retained test-output hash match the provided evidence. Tests were read/referenced, not rerun.

limitations: This is a source-review closure, not a live original database/transaction/content PASS. Original SQL execution remains subject to the parent coordinator's release and the actual runtime guards.
Focused fake-Client controls and short no-DB watchdog child tests do not prove the original database's current data or state.
The copy checks only project, selection, model and cable projections. Wider original/container and isolated-primary preservation is a separate parent audit.
The V8 heap cap is not a total process-memory bound. Candidate matches do not establish geometry readiness, visibility, business category acceptance or engineering approval.
